description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $70 - $90 per hour 
 
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor
 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
 Working Schedule: Flexible – Work on your own schedule
 Payment Frequency: Weekly via Stripe or Wise
 About the Role
 We are seeking experienced Open Source Software Engineers to contribute to an AI research initiative focused on improving the quality, reliability, and evaluation capabilities of advanced AI models.
 In this role, you will assess software engineering benchmark tasks used to train and evaluate frontier AI systems. You will review repository-level coding challenges, reference patches, test harnesses, and grading mechanisms to ensure that benchmark tasks are technically accurate, reproducible, and aligned with real-world software development practices.
 Your expertise in open-source development, repository maintenance, code reviews, and software testing will be essential in identifying flawed reference implementations, test weaknesses, answer leakage, and reward-hacking vulnerabilities.
 You will provide structured, rubric-based feedback to help establish reliable evaluation standards and improve the quality of software engineering benchmarks used in AI model development.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Benchmark Task Evaluation & Quality Assurance 
 Review repository-level software engineering tasks used for AI model training and evaluation.
 Assess benchmark task quality, technical accuracy, completeness, and reproducibility.
 Evaluate whether coding challenges reflect realistic software engineering problems and development workflows.
 Identify ambiguous task requirements, incomplete problem statements, and potential issues affecting benchmark reliability.
 2. Reference Patch & Test Harness Auditing 
 Audit reference patches to verify their correctness, completeness, and alignment with intended task requirements.
 Review test harnesses, test runners, and grading mechanisms to ensure accurate evaluation of model-generated solutions.
 Assess Docker-based execution environments and isolation mechanisms for consistency and reproducibility.
 Identify weaknesses in testing infrastructure, including missing test coverage and unreliable grading conditions.
 3. Benchmark Integrity & Vulnerability Detection 
 Detect answer leakage, test contamination, reward hacking, and other vulnerabilities that could compromise benchmark integrity.
 Evaluate whether grading systems accurately distinguish correct implementations from incomplete or artificially optimised solutions.
 Identify potential loopholes that allow AI models to achieve high scores without genuinely solving the underlying engineering problem.
 Recommend improvements to strengthen benchmark fairness, reliability, and evaluation accuracy.
 4. Research Collaboration & Technical Feedback 
 Collaborate with AI researchers, engineers, and evaluation specialists to improve software engineering benchmarks.
 Provide clear, structured, and actionable written feedback based on predefined evaluation rubrics.
 Translate practical open-source development and code-review experience into measurable quality standards.
 Help refine benchmark tasks, reference implementations, and evaluation methodologies.
 Required Qualifications & Skills
 Professional Experience 
 Minimum 3+ years of professional software engineering experience .
 Demonstrated involvement in open-source software development through merged pull requests, project contributions, or repository maintainer and committer responsibilities.
 Practical experience reviewing, maintaining, debugging, and improving production-quality codebases.
 Strong understanding of repository-level software development and collaborative engineering workflows.
 Open Source & Software Engineering Expertise 
 Proven open-source contribution or maintainer experience, with verifiable contributions to public repositories.
 Ability to review and audit reference patches, test runners, and automated grading systems.
 Strong understanding of Docker isolation, test execution environments, and reproducible software testing.
 Ability to identify answer leakage, reward hacking, test manipulation, and weaknesses in benchmark evaluation.
 Experience with Python and at least one additional programming ecosystem, such as Java, Go, TypeScript, or C++.
 Technical & Analytical Skills 
 Strong code-reading, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities.
 Understanding of software testing methodologies, test coverage, and code quality standards.
 Ability to assess whether software patches correctly address underlying issues without introducing regressions.
 Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and provide precise evaluation feedback.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Familiarity with SWE-Bench Verified or similar repository-level software engineering benchmarks.
 Maintainer or significant contributor experience in established Python open-source projects such as Django, Flask, scikit-learn, SymPy, or pytest.
 Previous experience in code review, software quality assurance, benchmark evaluation, or technical task grading.
 Experience working with automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and containerised development environments.
 Previous involvement in AI training, code evaluation, or AI model benchmarking is an advantage.
 Contract & Payment Terms
 Engagement will be on an independent contractor basis.
 The role is fully remote and offers flexible working hours, allowing you to complete assignments on your own schedule.
 Project duration may be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on business requirements and individual performance.
 Payments will be processed weekly through Stripe or Wise, based on services rendered.
 The role will not require access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any current or former employer, client, or institution.
 Candidates requiring H-1B or STEM OPT sponsorship are not eligible for this opportunity at present.
 Equal Opportunity
 All qualified applicants will be considered without discrimination based on legally protected characteristics under applicable laws. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application process upon request.
